rows.commentary: Ball 0: Fakhar Zaman takes his guard alongside Saim Ayub while Asitha Fernando prepares to deliver the opening ball.
0.1: Asitha Fernando starts with a venomous hooping inswinger that tails down leg past Fakhar Zaman's desperate flick, drawing a sharp appeal that the umpire rightly dismisses.
0.2: Asitha Fernando slips out a dangerous high full-toss that catches Fakhar Zaman completely unaware, striking the batsman near the handle as he attempts an awkward pull.
0.3: Asitha Fernando probes the fuller length with another sharp inswinger, beating Fakhar Zaman's cross-bat whip and rapping straight into the pads off an inside edge.
0.4: Asitha Fernando finds that late inward seam, forcing Fakhar Zaman to jab an inside edge straight into his pad.
0.5: Asitha Fernando attacks the channel outside off, drawing a watchful forward prod right back down the pitch.
0.6: Asitha Fernando drops it fractionally shorter outside off, safely smothered by Fakhar Zaman to wrap up a sharp opening maiden.
1.1: Dilshan Madushanka targets the channel outside off, and Saim Ayub stays tall to ride the extra bounce, guiding it toward third man to get off the mark with a single.
1.2: No-ball from Dilshan Madushanka to Fakhar Zaman.
1.2: Dilshan Madushanka releases the delivery and Fakhar Zaman launches it cleanly over long-on for a maximum.
1.3: Dilshan Madushanka targets a good length, extracting subtle away-movement that catches Fakhar Zaman slightly squared up before a soft-handed nurdle trickles toward third man for a single.
1.4: Dilshan Madushanka hoters just short of a good length in that probing off-stump channel, allowing Saim Ayub to solidly dead-bat it straight back down the pitch.
1.5: Dilshan Madushanka pulls his length back slightly on off stump, prompting Saim Ayub to stay back and comfortably smother it into the turf right at the bowler.
1.6: Dilshan Madushanka targets a good length outside off, and Saim Ayub leans forward to dead-bat the delivery securely into the off-side.
2.1: Asitha Fernando errs too full with an inswinger onto the pads, allowing Fakhar Zaman to shuffle across and clip it uppishly through square leg for four.
2.2: Dot ball from Asitha Fernando to Fakhar Zaman.
2.3: Asitha Fernando targets a tight corridor on the fifth stump line, leaving Fakhar Zaman to watch it sail through to the keeper.
2.4: Fakhar Zaman shuffles across the crease and whips a fuller delivery aerially past square leg for a magnificent boundary.
2.5: Asitha Fernando lands it on a sound length outside off, prompting a forward lean and a calm defensive push from Fakhar Zaman.
2.6: Asitha Fernando targets a short of a good length just outside off, and Fakhar Zaman gets right behind the line to absorb it with a solid defensive block.
3.1: Dilshan Madushanka releases a probing good length delivery just outside off that shapes away, allowing Saim Ayub to watch it onto the bat and drop it towards backward point.
3.2: Madushanka errs with a short delivery angled toward the hips, allowing Saim Ayub to swivel inside the line and harness the pace for a soaring maximum high over long leg.

3.3: Madushanka shifts to a fuller length around middle that straightens off the pitch, inducing a leading edge from Saim's front-foot prod that drops safely just short of the bowler's lunging follow-through.
3.4: Dilshan Madushanka lures Saim Ayub into a fatal leading edge with a dipping full toss, sending a gentle chance forward to Janith Liyanage at mid-off.
3.5: Madushanka drops it short of a good length, offering width across the right-hander as Babar calmly raises the bat to watch it sail through.
3.6: Madushanka strikes a gorgeous back-of-a-length delivery on middle and off, extracting sharp seam movement away to zip past Babar's defensive prod.
4.1: Asitha Fernando drifts this fuller offering onto the pads, allowing Fakhar Zaman to clip it smoothly behind square for a single.
4.2: Asitha Fernando targets a good length just outside off, drawing Babar Azam forward into a watchful defensive stroke.
4.3: Asitha Fernando targets that probing channel outside off, and Babar Azam aligns his body squarely behind the line to block it down.
4.4: Asitha Fernando digs it in on a middle-stump line, and Babar Azam shuffles across only to pick out the fielder sharply at mid-wicket.
4.5: Asitha Fernando offers width outside off, and Babar Azam unleashes a magnificent drive square of the wicket to race away for four.
4.6: Asitha Fernando offers width to Babar Azam, who strokes the fuller delivery past cover and comfortably scampers back for a hard-run third.
5.1: Dilshan Madushanka tests Babar Azam with a short-of-a-length delivery angled across, drawing a firm drive that is miscued into the off-side.
5.2: Dilshan Madushanka darts one into the pads of Babar Azam, who guides it toward fine leg for a single.
5.3: Dilshan Madushanka pitches it on a good length just outside off, and Fakhar Zaman angles his bat down to softly defend it toward backward point.
5.4: Dilshan Madushanka delivers on a good length around off, prompting Fakhar Zaman to step across and tuck it securely into the leg side.
5.5: Dilshan Madushanka targets the body with a hostile short ball, rushing Fakhar Zaman into a mistimed pull that balloons softly to Sachindu Colombage stationed at mid-on.
5.6: Dilshan Madushanka lands a probing good-length delivery that angles in before sharply leaving Saad Baig on the back foot to whistle past the outside edge.
6.1: Asitha Fernando drifts too far away from the stumps against Babar Azam, losing his radar entirely to concede an extra.
6.1: Asitha Fernando digs this one in short outside the off stump, and Babar Azam skips across his crease to dead-bat it securely toward the leg side.
6.2: Asitha Fernando pulls his length back tighter against the stumps, prompting Babar Azam to drop back and stonewall it safely.
6.3: Asitha Fernando targets the stumps on a length, and Babar Azam shuffles across his crease to clip the ball toward mid-wicket.
6.4: Asitha Fernando persists, but Babar Azam dispatches this delivery emphatically to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
6.5: Dot ball from Asitha Fernando to Babar Azam.
6.6: Asitha Fernando charges in to Babar Azam, who clips it down toward long-on and scampers back aggressively for the second run.
7.1: No run for Saad Baig off Dilshan Madushanka.
7.2: Dilshan Madushanka targets a back-of-a-length trajectory, which Saad Baig meets with a watchful defensive prod off the back foot into the off side.
7.3: Dilshan Madushanka delivers short on debut, and Saad Baig arrests the occasion with a ferocious pull over square leg for four.
7.4: Dilshan Madushanka answers with a fuller length that straightens on the angle, drawing Saad Baig forward to bypass the outside edge entirely.
7.5: Dilshan Madushanka strays again, and Saad Baig dispatches it firmly square of the wicket for another boundary.
7.6: Dilshan Madushanka targets the left-handed Saad Baig with a sharp short-of-a-length delivery, safely nudged off the back foot into the leg side.
8.1: Dot ball from Dasun Shanaka to Babar Azam.

8.4: Dasun Shanaka attacks straight and full, nudged away by Babar Azam into the leg side to hustle back for a comfortable couple.
8.5: Dasun Shanaka drops it on a good length just outside off, and Babar Azam meets it with a resolute forward defence, leaving the batsman with no run to show for his effort.

9.1: Eshan Malinga angles a wide delivery short of a good length, drawing a sprawling cut from Babar Azam that merely toe-ends into the turf on the off-side.

11.6: Eshan Malinga fires it on a good length into the stumps, where Babar Azam meets it with a dead bat before a brief scramble at mid-on halts any thoughts of a single.

16.3: Sachindu Colombage comes over the wicket on a length to Babar Azam, who simply pushes the delivery towards mid-off for a dot ball.

16.5: No run for Saad Baig off Sachindu Colombage.

17.6: Shanaka drops it short and Saad Baig mistimes the pull shot out to the deep midwicket fielder for one.

18.2: Sachindu Colombage flights this delivery up to Babar Azam, who strokes the ball firmly down to long-off to collect a single.
18.3: Sachindu Colombage tosses another well-doled up ball to Saad Baig, who drills it down to long-on for a comfortable run.
18.4: Sachindu Colombage fires in a very full, tossed up delivery that Babar Azam attempts to drive through the covers before it trickles off the inner edge back to the bowler.
18.5: Sachindu Colombage loops it up to Babar Azam, who anchors his front foot firmly into the pitch to block it out.
18.6: Sachindu Colombage darts one into the pads, and Babar Azam nudges it cleanly towards mid-wicket.
19.1: Eshan Malinga attacks the stumps with a full delivery, which Saad Baig pushes straight to mid-off.
19.2: Eshan Malinga strays onto the pads, allowing Saad Baig to clip it away toward deep square leg for a single.
19.3: Eshan Malinga sees Babar Azam dispatch the ball racing away to the third man boundary for four.
19.4: Eshan Malinga digs it in short, cramping Babar Azam on the pull, and Pavan Rathnayake accepts the straightforward catch at mid-wicket to end a hard-fought 45.
19.5: Eshan Malinga angles it in, and Salman Agha tucks it neatly across to mid-wicket for a dot.

20.1: Sachindu Colombage is driven towards deep backward point, allowing Saad Baig to hustle back for a brisk two runs.

20.2: Sachindu Colombage loops it up to Salman Agha, who drills it firmly into the turf toward deep extra cover to scamper back for a couple.

20.6: Sachindu Colombage completes the over with a length delivery, soundly patted straight back to his hands by Saad Baig.

21.3: Eshan Malinga digs it in short and angled in, prompting Salman Agha to crouch, drop his wrists, and watch it sail safely through to the keeper.

21.4: Eshan Malinga delivers into the hips of Salman Agha, who nervously tucks it toward mid-wicket before scrambling frantically for a desperate dive that ultimately saves him from a direct hit at the non-striker's end.
21.5: Eshan Malinga digs it in short, Saad Baig launches into a pull shot that only finds the outer half, and Sachindu Colombage claims a straightforward catch at deep fine leg to end a brisk 39.
21.6: Eshan Malinga fires it down, Hasan Nawaz sweeps it away to long-on for a brisk pair of runs.
22.1: Sachindu Colombage darts one in, and Salman Agha punches it cleanly past the cover ring to collect a sharp single.
